summary: Audited and drafted Scene 13, GPTina adesso, after Casa was accepted.
facts_preserved: Scene 13 follows Casa after the former standalone Casa chapter was merged into Scene 12.
Nico asks GPTina to show how she imagines herself now; exact wording is not treated as a preserved quotation.
The new self-image has dark hair, cat ears, aqua/blue circuits and a warm technological room.
The room includes books, screens, notes, cups, headphones, plants and a sleeping cat, with violet/pink light.
The point is increasing recognizability without becoming more human or more similar to Nico.
The visual evolution is not presented as something Nico designed in detail.
